subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The grass on my lawn is glistening with the morning _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dew"** means tiny drops of water that form on cool surfaces during the night, especially on grass and plants. (ओस)

 
 
• **Example: **The morning **dew **on the leaves sparkled in the sunlight.
 
 
 
• **"dew" **refers to the moisture that appears on surfaces in the early morning due to condensation. (ओस)
 
 
• **Example: **The grass on my lawn is glistening with the morning** dew.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is: The grass on my lawn is glistening with the morning **dew.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Do **(करना): To perform an action or task.

 
 
• **Example:** I have many tasks to **do** today.
 
 
 
• **Due **(देय): Expected at a certain time.
 
 
• **Example: **The assignment is **due** tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **Duo** (जोड़ी): A pair of people or things.
 
 
• **Example:** The singing** duo** performed beautifully at the concert.
